name: KUI
subtitle: A simple desktop app for Kafka
tagline: Your Kafka cluster, at a glance
summary: Most Kafka tools are command-line scripts or web dashboards you have to deploy. KUI is a desktop app: download it, add your cluster, and you’re looking at your data.
description: Most Kafka tools are either command-line scripts or web dashboards you have to deploy and keep running. KUI is neither.
It’s a desktop app: download it, add your cluster, and you’re looking at your data.

features.title: Topics
features.text: List, filter by regex, create and delete topics. Jump to any topic with ⌘K.

features.title: Messages
features.text: Read the newest or oldest messages, or watch them arrive live. View values as JSON, a tree or Base64, and export them.

features.title: Filters
features.text: Query messages by value and headers, e.g. value.status = 'shipped' AND headers.x-source IN ('web', 'ios').

features.title: Produce
features.text: Send your own messages, generate test data, or copy a message to another topic.

features.title: Consumer lag
features.text: See which consumer groups are caught up and which are behind, and reset their offsets.

features.title: Secure clusters
features.text: SSL and SASL clusters work too. Secrets are kept in the system keychain.
